defects.description: Geometry sweep flagged 2 plausibility flags (right_shoulder_flexion -118.5° outside [-60,180] band; right_hip_flexion 135° outside [-30,130] band) and 3 anomalies (knee_above_hip L+R, elbow_above_shoulder R). These are likely FALSE POSITIVES caused by the multi-axis global transforms (globalTilt:-18 + globalRoll:25 + globalTwist:30) which rotate the body, producing extreme derived body-frame angles that do not reflect actual anatomical impossibility. The base joint values (rightShoulder:-55, rightHip:95, leftHip:90, etc.) are within normal ranges.

Description says cross them at the shin. Baseline hipAbductL:-8 and hipAbductR:-8 are both slightly OUTWARD (negative = outward per actual renderer convention — comment is inverted). Joint coords show left ankle at x=-0.223 (figure left) and right ankle at x=+0.094 (near midline) — shins diverge (left goes left, right goes near-midline) rather than cross. VLM (front view) perceives shins as crossed, possibly due to perspective. Strict 3D shin-crossing not clearly achieved; testing symmetric hipAbductL/R:+15 produced ankles at x=+0.051 (L) and x=-0.172 (R) which swap sides but shins still do not strictly cross in 3D. Cannot confidently propose minimal fix without proper 3D line-intersection analysis or visual confirmation.

failing_tests.assertion: plausibility bands should be satisfied OR flags confirmed as false positives
failing_tests.expected: all derived joint angles within bands OR documented as transform-induced
failing_tests.actual: right_shoulder_flexion -118.5° (band [-60,180]); right_hip_flexion 135° (band [-30,130]) — but produced by globalTilt/Roll/Twist composition, not raw joint values

failing_tests.assertion: shins should cross in 3D (left ankle on figure right, right ankle on figure left, OR shins intersect)
failing_tests.actual: baseline: leftAnkle.x=-0.223 (figure left), rightAnkle.x=+0.094 (figure right) — ankles on NATIVE sides, not crossed

rationale: This pose uses 3 global transforms (globalTilt:-18, globalRoll:25, globalTwist:30) which produce extreme derived body-frame angles (right_shoulder_flexion -118.5°, right_hip_flexion 135°) that trigger plausibility flags but are transform-induced artifacts, NOT actual anatomical defects — the base joint values are within normal ranges. Anomalies (knee_above_hip, elbow_above_shoulder) are expected for a sideways-lean pose with crossed legs lifted off the bench. VLM cross-check (front view) perceives all 5 semantic claims as satisfied (sideways sit, lean toward armrest, both arms bent one on armrest one on bench, knees bent and crossed at shin, face tilted away). POTENTIAL concern: shin-crossing is hard to verify — baseline hipAbductL/R:-8/-8 are both slightly OUTWARD (renderer comment inverted; actual FK: negative = outward), and joint coordinates show ankles on native sides (left ankle figure-left, right ankle figure-right), suggesting shins diverge rather than cross. Testing hipAbductL/R:+15/+15 (both legs adducted INWARD) produces ankles that swap sides but shins still do not strictly cross in 3D. Cannot confidently propose minimal fix without (a) proper 3D line-intersection analysis of the shins, or (b) integrator visual confirmation. Defer to integrator review. NO FIELD CHANGES PROPOSED — pose may be acceptable as-is for visual rendering purposes.
